20: package org.apache.druid.server.metrics;
21: 
22: import com.google.inject.Inject;
23: import com.google.inject.Injector;
24: import org.apache.druid.discovery.NodeRole;
25: import org.apache.druid.guice.annotations.Self;
26: import org.apache.druid.java.util.emitter.service.ServiceEmitter;
27: import org.apache.druid.java.util.emitter.service.ServiceMetricEvent;
28: import org.apache.druid.java.util.metrics.AbstractMonitor;

30: 
31: import java.util.Map;
32: import java.util.Set;
33: import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong;
34: 
35: public class WorkerTaskCountStatsMonitor extends AbstractMonitor
36: {
37:   private final WorkerTaskCountStatsProvider statsProvider;
38:   private final IndexerTaskCountStatsProvider indexerStatsProvider;
39:   private final String workerCategory;
40:   private final String workerVersion;
41:   private final boolean isMiddleManager;
42: 
43:   @Inject
44:   public WorkerTaskCountStatsMonitor(
45:       Injector injector,
46:       @Self Set<NodeRole> nodeRoles
47:   )
48:   {
49:     this.isMiddleManager = nodeRoles.contains(NodeRole.MIDDLE_MANAGER);
50:     if (isMiddleManager) {
51:       this.statsProvider = injector.getInstance(WorkerTaskCountStatsProvider.class);
52:       this.indexerStatsProvider = null;
53:       this.workerCategory = statsProvider.getWorkerCategory();
54:       this.workerVersion = statsProvider.getWorkerVersion();
55:     } else {
56:       this.indexerStatsProvider = injector.getInstance(IndexerTaskCountStatsProvider.class);
57:       this.statsProvider = null;
58:       this.workerCategory = null;
59:       this.workerVersion = null;
60:     }
61:   }
62: 
63:   @Override
64:   public boolean doMonitor(ServiceEmitter emitter)
65:   {
66:     if (isMiddleManager) {
67:       emitWorkerTaskCounts(emitter, statsProvider);
68:     } else {
69:       emitIndexerTaskCounts(emitter, indexerStatsProvider);
70:     }
71:     return true;
72:   }
73: 
74:   public static long reportTaskCountDelta(AtomicLong count, AtomicLong lastReported)
75:   {
76:     long current = count.get();
77:     long previous = lastReported.get();
78:     lastReported.set(current);
79:     return current - previous;
80:   }
81: 
82:   public static Long computeIdleTaskSlotCount(WorkerTaskCountStatsProvider provider)
83:   {
84:     return Math.max(provider.getWorkerTotalTaskSlotCount() - provider.getWorkerUsedTaskSlotCount(), 0);
85:   }
86: 
87:   private void emitWorkerTaskCounts(ServiceEmitter emitter, WorkerTaskCountStatsProvider provider)
88:   {
89:     final Long failedCount = provider.getWorkerFailedTaskCount();
90:     final Long successCount = provider.getWorkerSuccessfulTaskCount();
91:     final Long idleSlotCount = provider.getWorkerIdleTaskSlotCount();
92:     final Long totalSlotCount = provider.getWorkerTotalTaskSlotCount();
93:     final Long usedSlotCount = provider.getWorkerUsedTaskSlotCount();
94:     if (failedCount != null) {
95:       final ServiceMetricEvent.Builder builder = new ServiceMetricEvent.Builder();
96:       builder.setDimension(DruidMetrics.CATEGORY, workerCategory);
97:       builder.setDimension(DruidMetrics.WORKER_VERSION, workerVersion);
98:       emitter.emit(builder.setMetric("worker/task/failed/count", failedCount));
99:     }
100:     if (successCount != null) {
101:       final ServiceMetricEvent.Builder builder = new ServiceMetricEvent.Builder();
102:       builder.setDimension(DruidMetrics.CATEGORY, workerCategory);
103:       builder.setDimension(DruidMetrics.WORKER_VERSION, workerVersion);
104:       emitter.emit(builder.setMetric("worker/task/success/count", successCount));
105:     }
106:     if (idleSlotCount != null) {
107:       final ServiceMetricEvent.Builder builder = new ServiceMetricEvent.Builder();
108:       builder.setDimension(DruidMetrics.CATEGORY, workerCategory);
109:       builder.setDimension(DruidMetrics.WORKER_VERSION, workerVersion);
110:       emitter.emit(builder.setMetric("worker/taskSlot/idle/count", idleSlotCount));
111:     }
112:     if (totalSlotCount != null) {
113:       final ServiceMetricEvent.Builder builder = new ServiceMetricEvent.Builder();
114:       builder.setDimension(DruidMetrics.CATEGORY, workerCategory);
115:       builder.setDimension(DruidMetrics.WORKER_VERSION, workerVersion);
116:       emitter.emit(builder.setMetric("worker/taskSlot/total/count", totalSlotCount));
117:     }
118:     if (usedSlotCount != null) {
119:       final ServiceMetricEvent.Builder builder = new ServiceMetricEvent.Builder();
120:       builder.setDimension(DruidMetrics.CATEGORY, workerCategory);
121:       builder.setDimension(DruidMetrics.WORKER_VERSION, workerVersion);
122:       emitter.emit(builder.setMetric("worker/taskSlot/used/count", usedSlotCount));
123:     }
124:   }
125: 
126:   private void emitIndexerTaskCounts(ServiceEmitter emitter, IndexerTaskCountStatsProvider provider)
127:   {
128:     emit(emitter, "worker/task/running/count", provider.getWorkerRunningTasks());
129:     emit(emitter, "worker/task/assigned/count", provider.getWorkerAssignedTasks());
130:     emit(emitter, "worker/task/completed/count", provider.getWorkerCompletedTasks());
131:     emit(emitter, "worker/task/failed/count", provider.getWorkerFailedTasks());
132:     emit(emitter, "worker/task/success/count", provider.getWorkerSuccessfulTasks());
133:   }
134: 
135:   public void emit(ServiceEmitter emitter, String metricName, Map<String, Long> dataSourceTaskMap)
136:   {
137:     for (Map.Entry<String, Long> dataSourceTaskCount : dataSourceTaskMap.entrySet()) {
138:       if (dataSourceTaskCount.getValue() != null) {
139:         ServiceMetricEvent.Builder builder = new ServiceMetricEvent.Builder();
140:         builder.setDimension(DruidMetrics.DATASOURCE, dataSourceTaskCount.getKey());
141:         emitter.emit(builder.setMetric(metricName, dataSourceTaskCount.getValue()));
142:       }
143:     }
144:   }
145: }
